newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 124 bln lire of Italy CTZs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 124 bln lire of Italy CTZs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for and bought 124 billion lire of two-year zero coupon certificates (CTZ) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 200 billion lire worth of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 8.28 trillion lire at the open auction for the October 31, 1998 paper, against 2.0 trillion lire worth of certificates on offer.
The auction price was set at 88.10 from 88.00 and gross yield at 6.55 percent against 6.98 percent at the previous sale of August 31, 1998 CTZs on October 10.
